key_provisions_or_claims: Extends Part 21 type-certification, production and design organisation rules to unmanned aircraft systems including their control and monitoring units (CMU).

Amends Art. 40 of Delegated Regulation 2019/945: certification required for UAS of 3 m+ over assemblies of people, carrying people or dangerous goods, or specific-category operations where risk cannot be mitigated otherwise.
Exempts research/experimental UAS produced in very limited numbers from type certification, using permits to fly instead.
Introduces CMU component eligibility, marking, EASA Form 15d and Form 52 for UAS statements of conformity.
annotation.summary_en: EU Commission Delegated Regulation 2024/1108 amends Regulation 748/2012 and Delegated Regulation 2019/945 to bring certified unmanned aircraft systems and their control and monitoring units under initial airworthiness certification, production and design organisation rules. It defines when UAS certification is mandatory and applies from 1 May 2025.
